verdict.rationale: Teller is an API product with client-certificate (mTLS) authentication, a simulated-data sandbox, and a community-built export script, so programmatic headless use for automation is plausible. However, linking accounts runs through the interactive Teller Connect flow, and nothing documents running it in CI or headless pipelines. missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guidance, a CLI or non-interactive enrollment path, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Teller API uses mTLS to authenticate the API caller. Teller issues client certificates that you use to connect to the Teller API.
The sandbox environment uses simulated data and never connects to real financial institutions.
I built a little script to export my accounts to CSV/QIF. Super easy to use API!
